items.description: Situated at high altitude in the Mokhotlong District, this area is famous for its diamond mines. It represents one of the highest altitude diamond extraction sites globally.
A remote mountain settlement in the Thaba-Tseka District, serving as a gateway to deep mountain interior routes.
Known for the Ha Baroana rock art site, which provides a glimpse into the region's ancient history through San paintings.
A small, quiet rural hamlet in the mountain highlands, reflecting the simple agrarian life of the local inhabitants.
Located in a mountainous area often used as a stopover for travelers navigating the challenging terrain towards the interior.
Famous for the Kome Caves, where historic dwellings are built directly into the rock face to protect against historical conflicts.
A village settlement that acts as an important point for accessing various trekking and adventure routes in the highlands.
A rural settlement in the southern lowlands, deeply engaged in subsistence farming and local communal living.
A border settlement located by the Tele River, which marks part of the frontier between Lesotho and South Africa.
A mountain village community in the Qacha's Nek District, providing support for local agrarian life.
A small community nestled in the rolling hills of the central districts, focusing on livestock keeping and farming.
A remote mountain settlement located in the Thaba-Tseka District, known for its rugged and pristine natural surroundings.
A small mountain settlement, providing a look at traditional life in the high-altitude areas of Lesotho.
